capabilities: Computes daily writing scores, streaks and focus time from note metadata
Draws heatmaps, stacked area charts, moon calendars and hour-of-week grids
Exports Markdown weekly and annual reports
Exports PNG and SVG share cards containing only aggregate numbers
Lists orphan notes, broken links, stale notes and near-duplicate titles
extras: Ships a separate Zotero XPI (1.1.0) with a seven-question reading panel; a sample-data mode fills every page with in-memory synthetic activity; history retention is destructive once a non-zero day count is set.
motivation: The author built it for a three-year-old personal vault to answer questions about monthly output, empty weeks and unread essays, after trying dashboards that wanted a sign-up or licence check first.
problem: Backlinks and the graph view do not show how much was written in a month, which weeks were empty, or whether an old note was ever reopened.

relations.evidence: Version 1.1.0 adds a second host: the same core, asked a different question.

summary: Local-only analytics dashboard that scores daily writing, draws heatmaps and charts, and exports reports and share cards.
